description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [50% Critical]/[100% Critical (25s)] to all allies if 0-2/3+ allies have any Attach Poison, grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode III (Wind, Poison)], [Poisoner Thieves Follow-Up] and [Crescent Gale] to the user

description.name: Hollow Edge
description.text: Six single attacks (0.80 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to all FF1 allies

description.name: Dagger Slash
description.text: Three single attacks (0.80 each), grants [Wind, Poison Ability +30% Boost 3] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Poisoner Thieves Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Poisoner Thieves after using a Thief ability

description.name: Crescent Gale
description.text: Grants [Crescent Gale 60% Critical]/[Crescent Gale 70% Critical]/[Crescent Gale 80% Critical]/[Crescent Gale 90% Critical]/[Crescent Gale 100% Critical] to all allies after using 1/2/3/4/5+ Thief abilities

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
